title: When a Rollaway Bed Joins the Per-Night Supplement Rate, Hotel Rate Plans
content:
The per-night supplement rate on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation is the plan's extra-adult amount, and on one set of facts the plan's rollaway amount joins it.

## The rule

1. Where an occupant stands beyond the standard occupancy, the folio carries no rollaway charge already posted and the rate plan booked charges for a rollaway bed, the per-night supplement rate is the plan's extra-adult amount together with its rollaway amount per night.
2. Where an occupant stands beyond the standard occupancy and the folio already carries a rollaway charge, the per-night supplement rate is the plan's extra-adult amount alone.
3. In every other case the per-night supplement rate is the plan's extra-adult amount alone.

A plan charges for a rollaway bed where the rollaway amount it carries stands above nothing. The folio carries a rollaway charge already posted where one or more rollaway lines stand on it.

## The two amounts each plan carries

| Rate plan | Extra adult, per night, USD | Rollaway bed, per night, USD | The two together, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 45.0 | 35.0 | 80.00 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 40.0 | 32.0 | 72.00 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 35.0 | 30.0 | 65.00 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 30.0 | 25.0 | 55.00 |
| Member Flex Rate | 25.0 | 25.0 | 50.00 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.00 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 85.0 | 0.0 | 85.00 |

The Suite Flexible Rate and the All-Inclusive Flex Rate carry a rollaway amount of 0.0 USD and so charge for no rollaway bed; on those two plans the first case is never reached.

## The combinations

| An occupant stands beyond the standard occupancy | A rollaway charge already stands on the folio | Plan charges for a rollaway bed | Per-night supplement rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| yes | no | yes | the extra-adult amount together with the rollaway amount |
| yes | yes | either way | the extra-adult amount alone |
| yes | no | no | the extra-adult amount alone |
| no | either way | either way | the extra-adult amount alone |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

On the Standard Flexible Rate, with 2 occupants standing beyond the standard occupancy over 4 nights:

- Where no rollaway charge stands on the folio, the per-night supplement rate is 30.00 USD together with 25.00 USD, which is 55.00 USD, and 55.00 USD multiplied by 2 occupants and by 4 nights is 440.00 USD.
- Where a rollaway charge already stands on the folio, the rate is 30.00 USD, and the same multiplication gives 240.00 USD.
